ttc_truth — DRIVE ttc op

• Data kinds: image2d × matrix × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ttc_truth(depth, K, T_rel, dt: 'float') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivettc; drivettc.ttc_truth(depth, K, T_rel, dt: 'float') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("ttc_truth"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

画素ごとの 真の τ(秒、最初のコマの時刻で)と閉じる速さ: {"tau", "closing_speed", "depth1", "valid"}。

τ₀ = Z₀ · Δt / (Z₀ − Z₁)(Lee 1976 の Z / (−Ż) を 2 コマの差分で。等速なら厳密)。近づかない画素(Z₁ ≥ Z₀)は inf。closing_speed = (Z₀ − Z₁) / Δt(m/s、正 = 近づく)。
